the pinned `honua-mcp-proxy` executable exits silently when launched through npm's node_modules/.bin shim; its published entry point is guarded on `process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`, which the shim path never satisfies. The same pinned bytes were launched by their resolved module path to read the tool surface (resolved module path). This is a defect in the pinned client artifact, not in the candidate server.
